prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Click Next to view a 10-second guide on desktop controls.", "How to Interact with Your Pet", "Drag your pet anywhere, right-click to hide or summon, and click to start chatting!", "Got It!", "Right-click your pet for controls & settings"]
1: ["Sign In to Keep Your Pets Safe", "Sign in with your existing account to instantly sync and preserve all your desktop companions.", "Using the same email restores your existing pets without resetting progress.", "Cloud Sync Safe"]
2: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Give your new companion a name to finalize the adoption certificate!", "Adopt Now", "Pet Name"]
3: ["Preparing Your Pet for Desktop", "We are generating animations and configuring desktop interactions.", "Desktop renderer ready", "Estimated time remaining: 15s"]
4: ["Choose Your Pet Journey", "Pick a ready-to-go companion or create a custom pet from your photos.", "Select Path"]
5: ["Ensure photos have good lighting and single subjects.", "Photo Preparation Tips", "For the best custom pet results, upload clear, well-lit photos facing forward.", "Continue to Upload", "Clear lighting, no blur, one pet visible"]
6: ["Your Companion is Ready!", "Your pet is now active on your desktop. Here is how to interact with it.", "Left-click to talk, click and drag to move, right-click for options.", "Desktop Control Tips"]
7: ["Secure Your Companion", "Create or sign into your account to unlock cross-device cloud saving and protect your pet.", "Cloud Save Included", "Never lose your custom pets or progress"]
8: ["Meet Your New Desktop Friend", "Select a companion to bring to life on your desktop.", "Listen to Voice", "Select Pet"]
9: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Sanctuary", "Bring Your Desktop to Life", "Discover virtual companions that live right on your screen.", "Begin Journey"]
